narr.Hutong Dubai: W43 users 1,388 against 1,655 last year, down 16.1%, with 62 GA4 bookings against 151, down 58.9%. Both years are counted on the create path only and no amendment events fired on either side, so the create path and the all paths basis give the same 62. Week on week users rose 49.1% from 931 and GA4 bookings rose from 54, but the conversion rate eased again to 4.5% from 5.8% and sits well under last year's 9.1%. The GA4 booking figure is a floor, and a lower one than last week. Measured against SevenRooms, which cannot be affected by anything on our own site, GA4 captured 62 of 109 website bookings created in the week, a ratio of 0.57, against 0.65 the week before and 0.85 to 0.99 through September and early October. A second, independent reading agrees: inside the same Google Ads account the GA4 imported booking action read 14.60 this week while the separately tagged WEBPAGE action on the same event read 28.00, a gap that has widened from 19.93 against 23.99 a week ago. So the fall in the GA4 series is substantially measurement, not trade. SevenRooms is the steadier read and it points the other way on the week: website bookings created rose to 109 from 83, up 31.3%, and all channels held at 314 against 307. Against last year the website channel is down 21.0% and all channels down 25.4%, so there is a real year on year softness underneath, but it is far smaller than the GA4 series implies. On advertising, Meta delivered on all seven days for the first time since the payment hold, spending AED 7,091 against AED 1,707. Two days ran at the pre hold rate, then budgets were raised on 28 October: both halved prospecting ad sets went from AED 180 to AED 400 a day, remarketing from AED 120 to AED 300 and awareness from AED 33 to AED 100. So this is a deliberate increase on top of the hold ending, not just restored delivery. Schedules recovered to 32 from 6. Google ran all week at AED 2,817 against AED 2,899. Google walk-in signals have now returned no rows for twelve consecutive weeks and are shown as a gap. That is a tracking gap on the account, not a real zero.
